package.name: exoskeleton_fdi_characterization
package.description:
FDI Phase 0 — characterization infrastructure.
Provides scheduler nodes, launch files, and offline analysis scripts to record: (a) healthy multi-regime baselines, with the trajectory input parameters varied automatically through a YAML-defined sequence, (b) systematic fault-injection sweeps over (channel x type x magnitude) with per-window metadata recorded in a manifest.json file.
Output: rosbag2 archives + manifest, suitable for offline calibration of FDI thresholds in Phases 3-5.
This package is a development tool. It is not part of the runtime safety chain and should not be loaded in production deployments.
